summary: Final region blocker resolved for the bounded public-only cost feature: all four actual public fixtures and their exported-plan variants verify us-west1, all 41 scoped core tests pass on Python 3.10.12, and conservative region guards remain intact. This is not approval of wider Task 28-29 gates or authenticated pricing.

scope.review_type: Independent final re-review after core fix cycle 2
scope.approved: Bounded public-only cost adapter core; final known region blocker and regression checks only
not_approved_open_gates: Private input and full private-data/telemetry policy
Native binary Terraform plans and native-platform acceptance
Authenticated G4 pricing and actual price acceptance

reviewed_sources: src/python/cost_estimate.py:513-636 estimate source usage, assertion guard and partial-report handling
configs/cost/README.md:100-128 fixture examples and region assertion semantics

tests.prior_guards_regression_status: Existing FIFO/runtime snapshot, Flex, free-component, usage and comparison checks still pass; no broader re-review or new feature requirements introduced.

independent_fixture_verification.method: Read each actual main.tf.json; call estimate on the actual fixture directory and on a temporary public exported-plan-shaped JSON containing its typed resources. Supply the documented usage file and assert us-west1. Mock runtime verification only and clear the authentication token; assert no pricing process invocation.
independent_fixture_verification.receipt_crosscheck: The supplied /tmp/isaac-cost-region-fix.json reports the same four fixture regions with separately checked pinned runtime binaries. This review did not repeat live binary verification or treat unauthenticated receipts as price quotes.

region_logic_verification.global_exception: Only the exact typed google_compute_network is exempt from absent region/zone/location evidence; network-only inputs remain unknown. Present location fields are still validated, including null and contradictory values.
region_logic_verification.uppercase_normalization: Only google_storage_bucket.location is lowercased. Bucket region, compute zone and other resource location keys do not receive that exception.
region_logic_verification.fail_closed: Unknown or billable resources without location, absent type/location evidence, unresolved values, US/EU/ASIA/NAM4 locations, malformed key/value combinations, mixed regions and contradictory fields cannot become verified_single. Asserted unresolved inputs stop before runtime verification; observed conflicts stop with region_conflicts_with_input.
region_logic_verification.saved_plan: The two added tests exercise exported-plan managed resources in child modules and exclude data resources from managed evidence. Independent probes also cover all four actual fixture resource sets as exported-plan variants.
region_logic_verification.text_hcl: Text HCL remains unverified rather than inventing per-resource binding.
region_logic_verification.without_assertion: Unverified/mixed region evidence remains partial and is excluded from verified input-backed comparison; it is not relabeled by an asserted region.

cases_in_each_mode: Known regional compute plus locationless typed network: verified_single
Network with explicit null region: unknown
Network with contradictory us-east1 region: mixed
Bucket location US-WEST1 plus contradictory region us-east1: mixed

documentation_verdict: README fixture commands with --region us-west1 now reach the authentication gate rather than region_unverified. Documentation correctly describes the flag as an assertion, preserves text-HCL limitations, and explicitly leaves broader unsupported features and authenticated pricing open.
